title.narrative: TH Institutional Capacity Building on ICT Policies in Thailand

description.narrative: " The MICT is responsible for ICT sector development agenda. The proposed project brings policy aspects in Thailand closer to international best practice by providing technical assistance to build up institutional capacity in the Ministry through strengthening policy analysis and formulation capacity. Specifically, the activities under the project will include: (1) Assist in strengthening policy analysis capacity through support for MICT staff's skill enhancement, including targeted training of the staff. The proposed activities will be supported by a combination of training and hands-on experience. (2) Assist in supporting policy formulation capacity through development of priority ICT policies including: a) Strengthening public sector reform and governance through e-government; b) Providing affordable access to broadband service, especially in rural areas; and c) Information technology sector development strategies, with a focus on SMEs. The proposed activities will be supported by technical assistance delivered by external consultants working with the staff of MICT. The project will help in developing policies for ICT sector growth in Thailand, taking into account international best practices in order to achieve the goal of a ""Smart Thailand"". The project will accordingly build capacity at Thailand's Ministry of Information and Communications through the engagement of local and international experts.
